t: ‘He wents’ vs. ‘he went’ in English
s: correct He went to the cinema. wrong He wents to the cinema. This is true for every verb (apart from “to be”) and every subject. A few examples: She had many friends. The toy broke. It arrived too late. The verb “to be” is the only exception. It is “was” in the first and third person singular and “were” in all other cases: I was ready.
